ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit affiliate StealBit data exfiltration over HTTPS prior to ransomware deployment
ucs.description: Hunts for LockBit's signature StealBit exfiltration tool (and its renamed variants) being launched from staging directories with HTTPS POST traffic to bulletproof hosting, a hallmark of LockBit 2.0/3.0 affiliate intrusions that precedes the actual ransomware detonation by 30-90 minutes.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("StealBit.exe","stealbit.exe","send.exe","send2.exe") OR (Processes.process_name="*.exe" AND (Processes.process="*https://*" AND Processes.process="*POST*")) OR (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe") AND Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" AND Processes.process_path="*.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count as conns values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ips dc(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as unique_dst sum(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,80,8080) AND All_Traffic.bytes_out > 10000000 by All_Traffic.src | rename All_Traffic.src as host] | where bytes_out > 50000000 | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let StealBitNames = dynamic(["stealbit.exe","send.exe","send2.exe","stb.exe"]);
let SuspectProc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName in~ (StealBitNames))
         or (FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Windows\Temp\")
             and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("https://", "POST", "--upload", "-u "))
         or (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stealbit|--upload|--threads\s+\d{2,3}).{0,200}https?://")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName;
let ExfilTraffic = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where RemotePort in (443, 80, 8080)
    | summarize TotalBytes = sum(toint(extractjson("$.bytes_out", AdditionalFields))),
                ConnCount = count(),
                DistinctRemotes = dcount(RemoteIP),
                FirstConn = min(Timestamp),
                LastConn = max(Timestamp),
                SampleUrl = any(RemoteUrl)
              by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessId
    | where ConnCount > 50 or DistinctRemotes == 1   // 50+ conns to single host = bulk upload
;
SuspectProc
| join kind=inner ExfilTraffic on DeviceId, $left.FileName == $right.InitiatingProcessFileName
| where Timestamp between (FirstConn - 5m .. LastConn + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine, SampleUrl, ConnCount, DistinctRemotes,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let StealBitNames = dynamic(["stealbit.exe","send.exe","send2.exe","stb.exe"]);
let SuspectProc = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where (TargetProcessName has_any (StealBitNames))
         or (ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\ProgramData\")
             and TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("https://", "POST", "--upload"))
         or (TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(stealbit|--upload|--threads\s+\d{2,3}).{0,200}https?://")
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let ExfilTraffic = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DstPortNumber in (443, 80, 8080)
    | where NetworkDirection =~ "Outbound"
    | summarize TotalBytes = sum(NetworkBytes),
                ConnCount = count(),
                DistinctRemotes = dcount(DstIpAddr),
                FirstConn = min(TimeGenerated),
                LastConn = max(TimeGenerated)
              by DvcHostname, SrcUsername
    | where TotalBytes > 50000000 or ConnCount > 50;
SuspectProc
| join kind=inner ExfilTraffic on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (FirstConn - 5m .. LastConn + 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName,
          TargetProcessCommandLine, TotalBytes, ConnCount, DistinctRemotes, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit StealBit Exfiltration Tool Execution
id: 7c8e9a2d-4f1b-4a3c-9e5d-1b2c3d4e5f6a
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of LockBit's StealBit data exfiltration utility or renamed variants from staging directories with HTTPS upload arguments.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1029/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.t1071.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_name:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\stealbit.exe'
      - '\send.exe'
      - '\send2.exe'
      - '\stb.exe'
  selection_path_cmd:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'https://'
      - '--upload'
      - '--threads'
  condition: selection_name or selection_path_cmd
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_name or selection_path_cmd) and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate file transfer utilities staged in unusual directories (rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\StealBit.exe OR *\stealbit.exe OR *\STEALBIT.EXE OR *\send.exe OR *\Send.exe OR *\send2.exe OR *\stb.exe) OR (@Image:(*\Users\Public\* OR *\PerfLogs\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\Windows\Temp\*) AND @CommandLine:(*https\:\/\/* AND (*--upload* OR *--threads* OR *POST*)))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\(stealbit|send2?|stb)\.exe$/i OR (ImageFileName=/\\(Users\\Public|PerfLogs|ProgramData|Windows\\Temp)\\/i AND CommandLine=/(https:\/\/.{1,200}(--upload|--threads|POST)|(--upload|--threads).{1,200}https:\/\/)/i))
| UserName!=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 RemotePort=443 | groupBy([aid, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=conns), count(field=RemoteAddressIP4, distinct=true, as=unique_ips)]) | conns > 50}, field=aid, include=[conns, unique_ips])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[count(as=execs), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])])

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit defense evasion: GPO-pushed binary execution with shadow copy deletion and recovery inhibition
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black's signature self-propagation chain — affiliate logs into a DC, pushes the encryptor via Group Policy, and the binary executes T1490 commands (vssadmin/wmic/bcdedit/wbadmin) within seconds. This GPO-delivery + recovery-inhibition combo is LockBit's distinctive lateral movement and is documented in CISA AA23-165A.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd_lines values(Processes.process_name) as procs dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("gpupdate.exe","svchost.exe","services.exe","taskhostw.exe") AND ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process="*stop*" AND Processes.process IN ("*sql*","*backup*","*veeam*","*memtas*","*sophos*")) OR (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" AND Processes.process="*Get-WmiObject*Win32_Shadowcopy*Delete*")) by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(process_name) as distinct_recovery_actions values(process_name) as recovery_cmds values(cmd_lines) as full_cmdlines values(parent_process_name) as parents by host user | where distinct_recovery_actions >= 2 | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RecoveryInhibition = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$" or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpupdate.exe","svchost.exe","services.exe")
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)delete\s+shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)shadowcopy\s+delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete catalog", "delete systemstatebackup", "DELETE BACKUP"))
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)Win32_Shadowcopy.{0,40}Delete")
         or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)stop\s+.{0,30}(sql|backup|veeam|memtas|sophos|msexchange|vss)")
    | extend RecoveryAction = case(
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe", "vssadmin-delete",
        FileName =~ "wmic.exe", "wmic-shadow-delete",
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "bcdedit-recovery-off",
        FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe", "wbadmin-delete",
        FileName =~ "net.exe", "net-stop-service",
        FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe"), "powershell-shadow-delete",
        "other")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              FileName, ProcessCommandLine, RecoveryAction,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
RecoveryInhibition
| summarize DistinctActions = dcount(RecoveryAction),
            ActionSet = make_set(RecoveryAction),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            CmdSamples = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            Window_sec = datetime_diff('second', max(Timestamp), min(Timestamp))
          by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| where DistinctActions >= 2 and Window_sec <= 300  // 2+ T1490 actions in 5 min = LockBit chain
| order by FirstSeen desc

    | extend RecoveryAction = case(

ucs.datadog_query:
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (
  (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* AND *shadows*))
  OR (@Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*))
  OR (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *bootstatuspolicy*))
  OR (@Image:(*\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBAdmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* AND (*catalog* OR *systemstatebackup*)))
  OR (@Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*Win32_Shadowcopy* AND *Delete*))
  OR (@Image:(*\net.exe OR *\Net.exe OR *\NET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*stop* AND (@CommandLine:*sql* OR @CommandLine:*backup* OR @CommandLine:*veeam* OR @CommandLine:*memtas* OR @CommandLine:*sophos*))
)
